checkEngineMissingLibrary: {{backend}} cannot start because a required library is missing ({{libraries}}), so Rey30 IDvj will run on CPU.

checkEngineUnavailable: This engine build cannot report GPU status
checkSearchNoVector: The embedding model returned no result, so file search will not work yet

checkSearchProbeFailed: Could not verify the embedding model
checkSearchUnavailable: This engine build cannot verify the embedding model
welcomeTitle: Rey30 IDvj needs to set up on your system
welcomeBody: This takes a few minutes: Rey30 IDvj downloads its inference engine and a small model for file search. You can keep using your computer while it runs.
